categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the medical and healthcare information technology sector, focusing on software sales, system integration, and technical services. Its business segments include intelligent medical and health services (HI), data governance and services (DI), artificial intelligence (AI) applications, public health information systems, internet healthcare applications, medical IoT solutions, and medical insurance application products. It serves hospitals, public health institutions, and healthcare management departments with comprehensive digital healthcare solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced IT technologies such as cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, and Internet of Things (IoT) to develop its products. It employs microservices architecture, low-code platforms, and modular technology frameworks for software development. The company follows CMMI5 software maturity processes and integrates AI large models, including proprietary medical AI models, to enhance clinical decision support and healthcare data analytics. It also emphasizes domestic technology adaptation and compatibility with national standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large and medium-sized hospitals, county-level health management institutions, public health agencies, and medical insurance bureaus across China. The company targets healthcare providers undergoing digital transformation, including tertiary hospitals and grassroots medical institutions. It also serves government health departments and participates in regional health information platform projects, internet hospitals, and smart city health initiatives.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant revenue contributions from East China, South China, North China, Central China, and Northwest China regions. It has projects and clients in over 30 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities. The company’s cloud and AI healthcare platforms have been deployed in multiple provinces and cities, including Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian, Guangdong, and Xinjiang.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the healthcare IT supply chain, providing software products, system integration, and technical services directly to healthcare institutions and government health agencies. It acts as a solution provider and technology enabler rather than a hardware manufacturer or end-user service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on accelerating digital transformation in healthcare through its 'HuiKang Cloud' strategy, emphasizing cloudification, AI integration, and ecosystem development. R&D priorities include enhancing the HI-HIS hospital information system, developing AI-powered clinical decision support tools, and expanding intelligent healthcare applications. The company collaborates with top universities and research institutes to advance medical AI models and promotes domestic technology adaptation for national security compliance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through software product sales, technical services including software customization and maintenance, and system integration projects. The company also earns income from cloud-based service subscriptions, operation and maintenance services, and internet healthcare platforms. It follows a direct sales model with contracts typically involving upfront payments and ongoing service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic healthcare IT solution provider in China, with a strong market presence and over 7,000 healthcare clients. It competes with other major Chinese medical software vendors and international players in the healthcare IT sector. Its strategic partnerships, such as with Philips, and its comprehensive product portfolio provide competitive advantages in the smart hospital and AI healthcare markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 1.42 billion RMB, representing an 11.96% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 173.5 million RMB. Despite revenue contraction due to market and project delays, the company maintains a substantial asset base exceeding 5.6 billion RMB and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures exceeding 269 million RMB. The company is undergoing a strategic transition with growth potential in AI and cloud healthcare services.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated, cloud-native, and AI-enabled healthcare IT solutions that support comprehensive digital transformation for hospitals and public health systems. Its products offer seamless data integration, intelligent clinical decision support, and scalable cloud services tailored to diverse healthcare scenarios. The company’s focus on domestic technology adaptation, extensive industry experience, and strategic collaborations enhance its ability to deliver secure, innovative, and high-quality healthcare IT ecosystems.
